durableFields.notes: Existing finalized CharacterBuild is the source for build-owned combat projection facts. Task 82 does not add lifecycle state to CharacterBuild.
Existing Character Sheet current Hit Points are the persistent pre-battle and post-settlement character-owned Hit Point fact.
Existing BattleState combatant Hit Points are the battle-owned mutation source during runtime.
Route events project existing layer handoff boundaries and owners; they are not stored as a duplicate lifecycle state machine.

notes: Task 82 introduced no new durable CharacterBuild, CharacterSheet, BattleState, or BattleCreatureState fields.
The lifecycle replay keeps Draft, Build, Sheet, BattleInitProjection, BattleRuntime, and Settlement as separate domain layers.

CharacterBattleBuildProjectionOwner, CharacterBattleSheetOwner, CharacterBattleInitProjectionOwner, CharacterBattleRuntimeOwner, and CharacterBattleSettlementOwner remain the durable owner vocabulary.
